Not devout or pious, inattentive, negligent. नास्तिबुद्धिरयुक्तस्य

Reduced to straits, miserable. -Comp. -कर्मन् m. an official (perhaps for आयुक्त˚). -कृत् a. doing improper or wrong acts. -पदार्थः the sense of a word to be supplied, as the sense of अपि q. v. -रूप a. incongruous, unsuitable; ˚पं किमतःपरं वद
Appointed, charged with (with gen. or loc.); ये तत्र ब्राह्मणाः संमर्शिनः युक्ता आयुक्ताः T.
क्तः A minister, an agent or deputy.
Provincial governor, according to lexicons; possibly a treasury-officer, in inscriptions (GI. p. 6. ff. EI.
Unreasonableness, want of conformity to correct principles.
Odd, uneven. -गम् Pre-yuga period, before cosmogonic time; आदौ कृतयुगे$युगे
. -Comp. -अर्चिस् m. Fire.-नेत्रः, -नयनः, -शरः See under अयुग्म. -सप्तिः having seven horses; युगपदयुगसप्तिस्तुल्यसंख्यैर्मयूखैः Śi.11.61.
अयुगपद् [ayugapad], ind. Not all together, gradually, seriatim; अयुगपदुन्नमितभ्रु वीक्षितम्
अयुगूः [ayugūḥ], f. A woman that bears only one child. (= काकवन्ध्या q. v.).
Not in pairs or couples; single, separate.
Odd, uneven (as a number) अयुग्मासु रात्रिषु
.-Comp. -छदः, -पत्रः having an odd (i. e. 7) number of leaves; the सप्तपर्ण tree; (Mar. सातवीण); नयत्ययुग्मच्छद- गन्धिरार्द्रताम्
. -नयनः, -नेत्रः, -लोचनः having odd (3) eyes, N. of Śiva; अर्धेन्द्रियक्षोभमयुग्मनेत्रः
.-बाणः, -शरः &c. having odd (5) arrows; N. of Cupid. -वाहः, -सप्तिः having seven horses, the sun.
अयुङ्ग [ayuṅga], a. Ved. Not existing in couples, odd, uneven. See अयुग्म. Śat.
Having no equal or companion. अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः

अयुज् [ayuj], a. Not being in couples, odd, uneven (opp. युज् even); अयुजि नयुगरेफतो यकारो युजि तु नजौ जरगाश्च पुष्पिताग्रा V. Ratn. -Comp. -इषुः, -बाणः, -शरः N. of Cupid (having 5 arrows). -छदः, = सप्तवर्ण (Mar. सातवण); ववुरयुक्छदगुच्छसुगन्धयः Śi.6,5. -पलाशः = सप्तपलाश. -पादयमकम् a kind of alliteration having the same syllables (in a different sense) in the first and third pādas -नेत्र, -लोचन, -अक्ष, -शक्तिः N. of Śiva.
To join, fasten or tie, yoke (to anything).
To fix or direct (the mind) towards; आयोजितस्तपस्यात्मा
To fix, or place; मालाः कदम्बनवकेसरकेतकीभिरायोजिताः शिरसि बिभ्रति योषितो$द्य Ṛs.2.21.
To make or form; कुसुमायोजितकार्मुको मधुः

. -तम् Ten thousand, a myriad. सूर्याब्धिसंख्यया द्वित्रिसागरैरयुताहतैः Sūrya. शाखानामयुतम् -Comp. -अध्यापकः a good teacher.-ता, -जित् Name of a king (son of Sindhudvīpa and father of Ṛituparṇa) Bṛi. Up. N. of another king (son of Bhajamāna;) V. P. -नायिन् N. of a king in the Mb. -सिद्ध a. (in Vaiś. Phil.) proved to be inseparable and inherent. -सिद्धिः f. proof that certain things or notions are inseparable and inherent. -होम a kind of sacrifice. B. P.
Unconquered, irresistible. अयुद्ध इद् युधा वृतम्
. -द्धम Absence of fighting or war. -Comp. -सेन a. of unconquerable armies (or arrows), irresistible. अयुद्धसेनो विभ्वा विभिन्दता
A weapon, shield &c.; it is of 3 kinds (1) प्रहरण, e. g. a sword; (2) हस्तमुक्त,e. g. a disc; (3) यन्त्रमुक्त, e. g. an arrow; आयुधानामहं वज्रम्
(pl.) Water (Ved.). -Comp. (-अ) आगारम् an armoury, arsenal; अहमप्यायुधागारं प्रविश्यायुधसहायो भवामि

. -आगारिकः Governor of an arsenal.-जीविन् a. living by one's weapon. (m.) a warrior, soldier. -धर्मिणी the tree called जयन्ती (रोगनाशने तस्या आयुधधर्मत्वात्). -पालः the governor of an arsenal; Hariv. -पिशाचिका 'devil of arms', devilish warlike spirit;
अयुध्य [ayudhya], a. Unconquerable, irresistible दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्यो
अयुवमारिन् [ayuvamārin], a. Where no young people die. Ait. Br.
Wind, अहं केशरिणः क्षेत्रे वायुना जगदायुना Mb.
The son of Purūravas and Urvaśī.-Comp. -षक् a. attached to; joined with men; सोमः पवत आयुषक्
आयुधिक [āyudhika], a. Relating to arms. -कः [आयुधेन जीवति ठञ्] A soldier, warrior.
आयुधिन् [āyudhin] आयुधीय [āyudhīya], आयुधीय a. [आयुध-इनि-छ] Bearing or using weapons. -धी, -धीयः A warrior; शिक्षाशक्तिं प्राहरन् दर्शयन्तो मुक्तामुक्तैरायुधैरायुधीयाः Śi.18.11.
आयुध् [āyudh], 4 Ā. To fight with, attack, oppose. -Caus. To oppose, attack, fight with; रथिनः पादचारमायोधयन्ति
आयुषम् [āyuṣam], (At the end of a few comps.) Life; e. g. पुरुषायुषजीविन्यः
That which proclaims age or duration of life.
(With Jainas) Connection with the body or person.
. (Generally used in dramas by elderly persons in addressing a nobly-born person; e. g. a charioteer addresses a prince as आयुष्मन्. A Brāhmaṇa is also so addressed in saluting; cf.
The third of the 27 Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic.
The Yoga star (कृत्तिका; the third lunar mansion.
आयुष्य [āyuṣya], a. [आयुः प्रयोजनमस्य, यत्] Promoting long life, vital, preservative of life; इदं यशस्यमायुष्यमिदं निःश्रेयसं परम्
ष्यम् Vital power, abundance of life or vigour.
N. of a ceremony performed after the birth of a child.
, शतायुर्वै पुरुषः Ait. Br.; प्राणो हि भूतानामायुः । तस्मात्सर्वायुषमुच्यते सर्वमेव त आयुर्यान्ति Tait.

N. of a ceremony called आयुष्टोम performed to secure long life, together with the गो and ज्योतिस् part of the अभिप्लव ceremony. (In comp. the final स् of this word is changed to ष् before hard consonants, and to र् before soft ones). -Comp. -कर a. (-री f.) promoting long life;
. -काम a. wishing for long life or health. -कृत् a. giving or producing life.

ghee. -योगः N. of a योग in astronomy. -वृद्धिः f. long life, longevity.-वेदः [आयुरस्मिन् विद्यते$नेन वा आयुर्विंदतीत्यायुर्वेदः Suśr.] the science of health or medicine, counted as a sacred science, and regarded as a supplement to the Atharvaveda; (it comprises 8 different departments; (1) शल्यम् surgery; (2) शालाक्यम् diagnosis of diseases belonging to the head and its organs; (3) कायचिकित्सा treatment of diseases of the whole body; (4) भूतविद्या treatment of diseases of the mind supposed to be caused by the influence of evil spirits; (5) कौमारभृत्यम् treatment of children; (6) अगदतन्त्रम् doctrine of antidotes; (7) रसायनतन्त्रम् doctrine of elixirs; and (8) वाजीकरणतन्त्रम् treatment of remedies to increase generative power); Śukra.4.277. -वेददृश्, -वेदमय, -वेदिक, -वेदिन् a.
acquainted with medical science, medical. m. a physician.
end or decline of life. -स्तोमः (आयुष्ठोमः) a sacrifice performed to obtain long life.
